values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/ambroselake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground', 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 25 sites 'for tents and RVs', large and spacious with generous room between them, moderately shaded; accessible sites #6 and #8. No length limit posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/ambroselake ('The campground offers 25 sites for tents and RVs, including accessible sites #6 and #8', 'the campsites are large and spacious', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch on the south side; carry-in kayak/canoe access on the north side and at some sites.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/ambroselake ('There are vault toilets', 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well', 'There's a boat launch on the south side and carry-in access for kayaks and canoes on the north'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/ambroselake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic MI DNR state forest campground on Ambrose Lake, 11 mi N of West Branch via South Fairview and Houghton Creek roads; some sites directly on the lake. Direct access to 9 miles of ORV/ATV trails. --Claude
summary: DNR page: 25 sites for tents and RVs, $20/night at the kiosk + Recreation Passport (fees.note), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat launch; first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Season (open all year, roads not plowed) already manual. Note trimmed of what the fields hold.
